rule: INV-11: every invariant maps to at least one mechanical check, or its gap is recorded as known debt. 'enforced' names checks that fail when the invariant is violated. 'partial' names checks that cover part of it and records the rest as debt. 'known_debt' names no check and says why.

check_kinds.test: file::exact test name in the Forge test suite
check_kinds.conformance: HC level and rule name in spec/handoff-conformance.json
check_kinds.key_rule: Key verifier rule ID at the release pinned in spec/verification-interface.md

invariants.title: Workflow before interface
invariants.debt: Whether the workflow was understood before interface work is a property of how the work was done. HC-1 requires Target Outcome and Required Task Steps sections, but nothing checks their order against interface work.

invariants.title: Schema before surface
invariants.debt: Construction order leaves no mechanical trace in a handoff, receipt, or Key run record.

invariants.title: Function before polish
invariants.debt: No check detects polish that disguises missing logic. Validation Checklists and receipts check function only where the checklist names it.

checks.fails_when: a handoff omits its Preservation Map

checks.ref: test/acceptance-receipt.test.js::modified handoff and missing bound files cannot inherit verification
checks.fails_when: a preserved, hash-bound file is changed or removed before acceptance

checks.ref: test/acceptance-receipt.test.js::input mutation during a successful command disputes it and blocks later checks
checks.fails_when: a check modifies a bound input while it runs

invariants.title: Assumptions are labeled

checks.fails_when: the Context section carries no status label

checks.ref: test/handoff-validate.test.js::unlabeled status item fails HC-2 but passes HC-1
checks.fails_when: a Status Declaration item has no status label

invariants.debt: HC-2 checks that labels are used, not that every assumption is stated. The HC-2 known_enforcement_gap in spec/handoff-conformance.json applies.

checks.fails_when: a component in the Status Declaration is not labeled real, simulated, planned, or unknown

checks.ref: test/acceptance-receipt.test.js::failed, unavailable and timed-out checks never verify a claim
checks.fails_when: a claim would be reported verified without a passing check

checks.ref: test/acceptance-receipt.test.js::empty claim evidence stays unchecked and partial check selection stays unchecked
checks.fails_when: a claim without selected evidence would be reported verified
a run is recorded as passing while a gate did not pass

invariants.title: Local simulation only where useful
invariants.debt: The simulated label exists, but nothing detects a simulated service presented as live, and usefulness is a judgment.

invariants.title: Model-native adaptation
invariants.debt: HC-1 requires a Receiving Actor section, but whether instructions are adapted to the receiving system is not mechanically checkable.

checks.fails_when: a required section, including the Preservation Map or Validation Checklist, is missing or empty
a handoff omits its Preservation Map (the HC-1 rule covers every required section)
a gate the route requires recorded no decision
a failing gate is recorded in a passing run

checks.ref: test/key-verify.test.js::a run passes only when every ci gate recorded a passing decision
checks.fails_when: a missing or failing gate decision would let the run manifest claim pass
a Validation Checklist item maps to no executable check

checks.ref: test/invariant-enforcement.test.js::every invariant is mapped once, and every named check exists
checks.fails_when: an invariant is missing from this map, or a named check does not exist
